title: Change `cssClasses` jsdoc from `{string|string[]}` to `{string}`
body:
The jsdoc usage of our widgets on the accepted types of `cssClasses` is inconsistent. We sometimes use `{string|string[]}` and sometimes `{string}`.

We have absolutly no tests that ensure that the array syntax works and we did not even used it once in our demos. I suggest we update all the jsdocs to only use `{string}`
